## Design decisions recorded at implementation

Full rulings in ADR-0313; the load-bearing ones:

- **Conditioned compaction rules resolve by declared
  profile/compliance — never model identity.** Declared
  inputs are a subset of `{ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}`;
  a conditioned rule carries a complete
  `AssumptionDebtRecord` at registration or is
  inadmissible; resolution walks canonical rule order.
- **Model-owned compaction faces the identical kernel
  invariants** — `ModelCompactCall` parses through a closed
  grammar to the same `CompactionOp` sum; I-REQ/I-NOWIDEN/
  I-CUT/I-RECLAIM apply unchanged.
- **A provider that cannot report its forgotten set records
  `forgotten = {range: "all_prior"}`.** The submitted blocks
  are forgotten at minimum, plus every non-`required` view
  item before `insert_at` — the record survives even when
  local reclaim arithmetic is what a fallback would see
  (the semantic loss is never erased by the ladder).
- **Demotion routes to `external` only** — never inward,
  never upward, never a silent drop; `Demotion` records
  ride the assembly outcome.
- **`PlanMap` admits exactly `Branch`/`Invoke`/`Verify`**
  — `Loop`/`Delegate`/`Opaque`/`Instruction` are
  `UncheckableSurface` (code-mode by definition); invokes
  are `⊆ allowed_capabilities`; the reference variant is a
  primitive/split rendering.
- **Synthesis is S1→S4 fail-closed with the gate named**;
  admission additionally requires a *complete* debt record
  (`debt` gate before the safety gates).
- **`shim` is an exact table** — `UnknownSurface` on a
  miss, never a best-effort match; interpreter calls meter
  `model_call` under the calling role's token role.
- **`similarity_rerank` refuses a mismatched/unpinned
  embedder** — the `embedder_ref` is a pin member, scoring
  is integer-only ppm math, calls are accounted.

One implementation-round regression was caught and fixed
in-run before closeout: the `provider_compaction` variant's
`insert_at = 0` selection produced zero local reclaim on an
unreported forgotten set, which let the fallback ladder
replace the provider result and erase the `all_prior`
marker — the fix makes the submitted blocks forgotten at
minimum (the provider consumed them) so a valid delegated
compaction always records its loss.

## Removability

`removability(0…3)` green (serial script run). Every new
surface is additive (CC8): `Restructure`/`ProviderCompact`
are `CompactionOp` sum members, the policy variants are
`PolicyKind` members, the surface family extends
`CompileExposureMode`/`BindingMapping`, the embedder port is
a caller-supplied trait, and `AssembleRequest.
demotion_wrappers` defaults empty — C0 fixtures decode and
run unchanged. No new crate, no new feature gate.
